segments.name: Railroad and Utility Products and Services
segments.description: Treats and sells railroad ties and utility poles to railroad and utility industries in North America and Australia.
segments.evidence: Our RUPS business primarily sells pressure-treated railroad ties to the railroad industry in the United States and Canada and treated utility poles to utility markets in the United States and Australia.

segments.name: Performance Chemicals
segments.description: Develops and manufactures wood preservation chemicals and fire-retardant chemicals for treated lumber across global markets.
segments.evidence: The primary products supplied by PC are copper-based wood preservatives, including micronized copper azole (MicroPro®), micronized pigments (MicroShades®), alkaline copper quaternary, amine copper azole, DCOI and CCA.

revenueModel.text: Customers in railroad, utility, lumber treating, aluminum, steel and other industries pay for treated wood products, preservation chemicals and distilled coal tar products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products and services are used in a variety of niche applications in a diverse range of end-markets, including the railroad, specialty chemical, utility, residential lumber, agriculture, aluminum, steel, rubber and construction industries.

changes.text: In 2025, the company discontinued phthalic anhydride production at its Stickney, Illinois facility in the second quarter.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, we decided to discontinue phthalic anhydride production at our facility in Stickney, Illinois.
